name: vive-zarzal
description: Foro comunitario de comida: comparte platos y recetas
author: Cristian Camilo <cristianco9>

scripts.test:setup: npm run migrations:run && npm run seeds:run
scripts.migrations:run: sequelize-cli db:migrate --config src/db/config.cjs --migrations-path src/db/migrations --models-path src/db/models --seeders-path src/db/seeders
scripts.migrations:revert: sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo --config src/db/config.cjs --migrations-path src/db/migrations --models-path src/db/models --seeders-path src/db/seeders
scripts.migrations:delete: sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --config src/db/config.cjs --migrations-path src/db/migrations --models-path src/db/models --seeders-path src/db/seeders
scripts.seeds:run: sequelize-cli db:seed:all --config src/db/config.cjs --migrations-path src/db/migrations --models-path src/db/models --seeders-path src/db/seeders
scripts.seeds:revert: sequelize-cli db:seed:undo --config src/db/config.cjs --migrations-path src/db/migrations --models-path src/db/models --seeders-path src/db/seeders
scripts.seeds:delete: sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all --config src/db/config.cjs --migrations-path src/db/migrations --models-path src/db/models --seeders-path src/db/seeders
